title: LitArc-Bench: Disentangling Text-Specific Reader-Response Dynamics from Position and Lexical Affect
abstract: arXiv:2611.18412v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: When model predictions track an unfolding human affect trajectory, alignment may reflect narrative position, affective words, or text-specific reader-response dynamics. We introduce LitArc-Bench to separate these explanations: 39 Chinese-language literary excerpts segmented into seven checkpoints, with 430 questionnaires from 81 adults in two classroom groups (9,020 VAD ratings). We compare three future-blind model runs with leave-one-text-out position priors, lexical affect, and human-human references. Position alone reaches r = .470 for arousal, making raw alignment insufficient. Yet all six V/A transition advantages over a joint position-lexicon control have text-bootstrap intervals above zero. Cross-fitted models match the correct human text better than 38 mismatched texts in all nine model-dimension cells (p < .0001); a text-invariant negative control returns chance (p = 1). translated_title: LitArc-Bench：将文本特异的读者反应动态从叙事位置与词汇情感中解耦
translated_abstract: 当模型预测能够跟踪人类情感轨迹的逐步展开时，这种一致性可能反映的是叙事位置、情感词汇，或文本特异的读者反应动态。我们提出LitArc-Bench来区分这几种解释：该基准由39段中文文学节选构成，划分为七个检查点，包含来自两个课堂群体81名成人的430份问卷（共9,020个VAD评分）。我们将三种“前瞻盲”模型运行与留一文本法位置先验、词汇情感基线以及人际参照进行比较。结果表明，仅凭位置因素对唤醒度（arousal）的相关系数即达r = .470，说明单纯的原始对齐不足以说明问题。然而，相对于位置-词典联合控制基线，全部六项效价/唤醒度（V/A）转换优势的文本自助法置信区间均高于零。交叉拟合模型在全部九个模型-维度组合中，对正确人类文本的匹配均显著优于38个错配文本（p < .0001）；而文本不变的阴性对照仅返回随机水平（p = 1）。在人类情感转换幅度相对位置基线至少0.5分时……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出LitArc-Bench基准（39段中文文学节选、9,020个VAD评分），通过位置先验与词汇情感对照实验，首次证明模型与人类情感轨迹的匹配中存在超出叙事位置和情感词汇的文本特异读者反应动态成分。
en_tdlr: LitArc-Bench, built from 39 Chinese literary excerpts with 9,020 VAD ratings, provides controlled evidence that model-human affect alignment reflects a genuine text-specific reader-response dynamics component beyond narrative position and lexical affect.
